details.summary: Norwegian politician and fifth Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO) 1998-2003
details.life: Was born 20 April 1939 in Bærum near Oslo, Norway. She is the daughter of Gudmund Harlem, physician and politician, and Inga Margareta Elisabet Brynolf, political party employee. On 9 December 1960 she married Arne Olav Brundtland, political scientist. They have one daughter and three sons.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
